catalog_scope: same frozen tablet catalog and review corpus as the official holdout
design_note: Twenty four-turn episodes authored after the SEGSE v1.4 method freeze and after the confirmatory protocol freeze, over the same 117-product / 7552-review tablet catalog the official holdout used. Gold carries typed current-turn state events, which the earlier 20-episode holdouts cannot express because their gold_state_diff collapses every mutation into upsert:<id>. No utterance is reused from any earlier fixture or holdout, and the development microSD sentence is deliberately absent; its failure family reappears as six different dimension-confusion surface forms. Every declared downstream effect is re-derived from the deterministic Query Generator and Policy before the freeze.
